note: Two High paths were judged overstated: `dorny/paths-filter@v4` is an output-only action (it computes changed paths or a branch status) in a job with no secret and a token whose write scope is assumed or scoped, and `amannn/action-semantic-pull-request@v6` reaches a pull-requests token on same-repository runs, Medium at most.

ceilings.pending: a `needs` output the dependent job only compares in its `if:` (the edge is recorded as `output_compared`) still carries the dependent's write token and its push into the reach of the entry job.
the spec counts any write scope of the token as a write token, while the assessment argued that a token scoped to issues, pull requests or checks only, in a job with no secret, is a Medium at most.
